name: Return to Corporal Kaleb
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Corporal Kaleb waits for the pot Krazek repaired in Booty Bay. It has a second steam whistle and a chopper built into its base.

sections.title: A Better Pot
sections.body: Krazek has finished repairing the pot you brought him. He added another steam whistle and fitted a chopper to its base, sharp enough to cut through leg bones. He calls it a sure way to please the cook and expects its owner to be glad of the changes. Now it is ready to return to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

sections.title: Back at the Camp
sections.body: Corporal Kaleb is delighted to see the pot working, and at last dinner can begin. He hopes your time in Booty Bay went well, though he calls it a rough town. He also shares a rumor: goblins sometimes drag drunken sailors away to slave boats bound for parts unknown.

faq.answer: Corporal Kaleb waits at the Rebel Camp for the cooking pot Krazek has been repairing in Booty Bay.

faq.q: What did Krazek do to the pot?
faq.answer: Krazek repaired the pot, added another steam whistle, and fitted a new chopper into its base, sharp enough to cut through leg bones.

aliases: what led to return to corporal kaleb
